# Intro

Build on top of redsun to create your own
applications, integrations, and agent experiences without starting from
scratch.

We also offer Effect APIs for [plugins](plugins/effect.md) and
[clients](client/effect.md).

- [Extend redsun](plugins/index.md): Build plugins that add tools, integrations, commands, agents, and custom behavior while keeping the rest of redsun intact.
- [Run it as a server](client/index.md): Connect to redsun with the same client used by the TUI, then build any interface, workflow, or agent experience around it.
